correctness.rationale: Exact one-step Markov conditional regression and one-/two-label absence identities reconstruct the mean, covariance and finite q=2 variance. The martingale decomposition is an exact telescoping identity. Bounded differences give the concentration bound; L2 unseen-fraction convergence and explicit conditional variance expansions establish the normalized bracket, while q/sqrt(n) bounds the scaled increments and verifies Lindeberg. The martingale CLT then rigorously proves the Gaussian limit, and all 961 exact rational checker assertions passed. Finite checks are not treated as proof of asymptotic claims.

originality.rationale: The exact Gaussian limit, sharp nonzero variance coefficient and temporal covariance for constant stage duration q>=2 are not asserted in the motivating full preprint or full journal article. The primary source treats expected unseen counts and specifically states concentration as future work. The classical q=1 Eulerian law and permutation deficiency-set identification are fully credited and excluded from originality. Public research-record and scholarly searches for equivalent stage-varying occupancy and common permutation deficiency CLTs did not uncover a dominating prior theorem. Remaining broad general occupancy literature warrants independent historical review.
residual_risks: A general triangular-array occupancy or martingale normal-limit result may subsume the Gaussian statement; the literature search cannot certify historical uniqueness.
